title: 3 Units • Sleeps 24 • Minutes to Downtown/Airport
description:
Perfect for large groups! This unique Nashville retreat combines 3 modern condos to comfortably sleep 24 guests. Enjoy the privacy of 6 bedrooms & 5.5 baths while being just minutes from Downtown, the Grand Ole Opry, and BNA airport. The ideal home base for your Music City adventure!

The space
Discover your perfect Nashville retreat for large groups! This unique offering combines three separate, modern condo units, providing a comfortable and private home base for up to 24 guests. Located just steps from each other, these homes offer the ideal blend of togetherness and personal space.

Inside each thoughtfully designed unit, you'll find a cozy, welcoming atmosphere. With a total of six beautifully appointed bedrooms and five and a half bathrooms across the three condos, your group will have plenty of room to relax and recharge.

Bed Configurations:
* Unit 1 (Sleeps 8):
    * Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with en-suite bathroom.
    * Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, Bunk Bed (2 Twins), and a Twin Trundle with en-suite bathroom.
* Unit 2 (Sleeps 8):
    * Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with en-suite Jack-and-Jill bathroom.
    * Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, Bunk Bed (Twin over Full), with en-suite Jack-and-Jill bathroom.
* Unit 3 (Sleeps 8):
    * Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with en-suite bathroom.
    * Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, Bunk Bed (2 Twins), and a Twin Trundle with en-suite bathroom.

Guest access
Guests will have complete and private access to all three condo units included in the booking. You are welcome to use all spaces within the homes, including the common areas and the back porch.

Other things to note
* Noise Potential: The condo is located near railroad tracks and the airport, so you may experience some related noise during your stay.
* Shared Walls: This is a condo complex, and our unit shares one wall with an adjoining condo. You may occasionally hear creaks from the floor or water running through pipes.
* Decorative Fireplace: The fireplace is for ambiance only. Please do not burn anything in it.
* Starter Supplies: We provide a starter kit of supplies (toilet paper, paper towels, etc.) to begin your stay. Guests are responsible for any additional items needed.
* Liability: All listed amenities are to be used at the guest’s own risk. The homeowner is not liable for any risk, danger, injury, or damages.
